note: Arcade handling presets (P1-FL04, R128; crates/jj-sim/src/vehicle/handling.rs). A profile's tuning.handling takes one of these; the Feel Lab switches them live. Grip values multiply the wheel's friction coefficient (profile friction_slip x ground x drift); slip angles are degrees on tarmac; the yaw helper adds rotation toward the stick only.

presets.what: Planted and pointy: high grip at both ends, a shallow fall-off past the peak, a strong yaw-rate feel. Turns in on rails at any speed.
Loose and lively: a later, softer peak and a deeper fall-off, big lift-off rotation from weight transfer. Throw it in, catch it on the throttle.
Tail-happy: less rear grip than front, drive eats most of the rear's grip, so a rear-driven car steps out under power and holds a slide.
